_comment: Properties an operator may set as DESIRED state from Horizon, through s4t-twin-api.
Anything not listed here is refused before it reaches Ditto. An empty or unreadable file refuses everything.
'default' applies to every board. 'by_board_type' adds or overrides entries for one board type (the twin's attributes/boardType).
'by_profile' is keyed by the twin's attributes/machine/profile and, when it matches, REPLACES everything else: a machine profile describes its controls completely.
Types: boolean, integer, number, string. Optional: min, max (numbers), enum (any type), max_length (strings), unit, description.
Re-read on every request, so an edit takes effect without a restart.
The cnc_mill entry must match CONTROLS in scripts/s4t_machine_model.py; test_twin_api.py checks that it does.
Phase 3 replaces this file with the twin definition from the D8.1 SDF model.

fan_on.description: Cooling fan on or off. Understood by scripts/s4t_mock_board.py.

run.description: Spindle running. After an alarm the machine needs OFF, then ON.

mode.description: Operating mode. Maintenance stops the spindle, clears an alarm and changes the tool.

spindle_speed_setpoint_rpm.description: Spindle speed setpoint. Below 1380 rpm with coolant on, heat dissipation can fail.

feed_override_pct.description: Feed override: scales the cutting load. Too high at high speed overloads the spindle.
